comment: Sophie was absolutely wonderful! The café she chose was charming, and I learned so much practical French. Her teaching style is relaxed yet effective. Can't wait to book another session!
Perfect for beginners! Sophie made me feel comfortable speaking French even though I was nervous. The croissants were amazing too! 🥐
Carlos is fantastic! His knowledge of Barcelona and Spanish cuisine is incredible. We visited three amazing tapas bars and I practiced ordering in Spanish at each one. Highly recommend!
As an anime fan, this was a dream experience! Yuki taught me so much practical Japanese that I can actually use. The vintage shops were incredible. Worth every yen!
Yuki is the best teacher! She made Japanese feel approachable and fun. Loved exploring Harajuku with someone who knows all the cool spots.
This experience was everything I hoped for! Ji-woo is so patient and enthusiastic. We practiced K-drama phrases and I can finally understand some scenes without subtitles!
Great energy and fun atmosphere! I'm not much of a dancer but Miguel made it easy and enjoyable. My Spanish improved and I learned some salsa moves. Win-win!
Intellectually stimulating and beautifully executed. Pierre's passion for French poetry is contagious. The wine selection was perfect. A must for literature lovers!
Incredible experience! Sakura is an amazing teacher and the ramen we made was restaurant-quality. Learned tons of Japanese cooking vocabulary. My friends were impressed when I made it at home!
Perfect for professionals! Hans showed us Berlin's innovative startup scene while teaching business German. Very practical and inspiring.
Isabel's voice is beautiful and her teaching is even better. I finally understand what saudade means! The fado performance was emotional and unforgettable.
Best food tour ever! Min-ji is so knowledgeable about Korean street food. Tried tteokbokki, hotteok, and bindaetteok while learning Korean. My taste buds and brain are both happy!
Layla made Arabic accessible and beautiful. The calligraphy workshop was therapeutic and educational. I'm keeping my artwork framed in my office!
Dmitri's knowledge of Russian literature is profound. We had fascinating discussions about Dostoevsky over chess. Challenging but rewarding!
Carlos brought Gaudí's architecture to life! Learned so much Spanish architectural vocabulary while being amazed by the buildings. Sagrada Familia was breathtaking.
Elena is a culinary goddess! Making fresh pasta while learning Italian was pure joy. The wine pairing lesson was an unexpected bonus. Delizioso!
Yuki knows Akihabara like the back of her hand! Found so many rare manga and learned tons of otaku vocabulary. Paradise for anime fans learning Japanese!
Min-ji is a K-beauty expert! Learned all the Korean terms for my skincare routine and discovered amazing products. My skin and Korean both improved!
Beautiful experience! The fado music was touching and Isabel explained the lyrics and cultural context perfectly. Only wish it was longer!
Loved every minute! Carlos is funny, knowledgeable, and passionate about Barcelona. The tapas were incredible and my Spanish ordering skills leveled up!
Profound and peaceful. Sakura's tea ceremony was a meditation in language learning. Understanding keigo and Japanese formality made so much more sense after this.
Thomas made learning Mandarin fun and practical! Making dumplings while practicing Chinese was genius. Plus, the dumplings were delicious!
Architecture lover's dream! Carlos explained Gaudí's work brilliantly in Spanish. Park Güell was magical. This experience motivated me to continue learning Spanish.
¡Increíble! Miguel showed us the real CDMX through food. Learned authentic Mexican slang and ate the best tacos of my life. My stomach and Spanish both thank you!
Magical sunset experience! Isabel took us to the most beautiful viewpoints in Lisbon. Practicing Portuguese while watching the golden hour was perfection.
So much fun! Singing in Japanese really helped my pronunciation. Yuki was encouraging and we laughed so much. Best way to learn Japanese!
Living my K-drama fantasy! Ji-woo made learning Korean romantic phrases fun and practical. The café was straight out of a drama scene!
Sophie is a great teacher! The café atmosphere was perfect for learning. Only downside was it ended too quickly - wished it was 3 hours instead of 2!
Hands-on and delicious! Sakura taught us proper Japanese cooking terms and techniques. The ramen was authentic and amazing. Taking the recipe home was a great touch!
Elena's passion for Italian cuisine and language shines through! Made the best pasta I've ever tasted while learning Italian cooking vocabulary. Magnifico!
Gwangjang Market at night is incredible! Min-ji knew all the best vendors and taught us how to order like locals. Ate so much delicious food!
Perfect for J-fashion lovers! Yuki showed us hidden vintage shops and taught modern Japanese slang. Harajuku was even cooler with a local guide!
Fado touches the soul! Isabel's voice and teaching both moved me. Understanding Portuguese through music was a beautiful experience.
Barcelona's Gothic Quarter is stunning! Carlos made the tapas tour educational and fun. Learned food vocabulary and discovered amazing restaurants!
Miguel is hilarious and knows the best street food! Coyoacán market was amazing. My Mexican Spanish improved so much in just one night!
Hans is brilliant! Perfect for anyone interested in tech and business German. Berlin's startup scene is inspiring and I learned practical business vocabulary.
Serene and enlightening. Sakura's tea ceremony was a window into Japanese culture and formality. The matcha was perfect and the learning environment was peaceful.
Sophie creates a welcoming learning environment! The café was charming and my confidence in speaking French improved dramatically. Merci beaucoup!
K-beauty heaven! Min-ji explained everything in Korean and English. Myeongdong was overwhelming but she guided us perfectly. Got amazing skincare and language skills!
Otaku paradise! Yuki found rare manga I've been searching for and taught me all the Japanese I need to read it. Akihabara with a guide is essential!
Best karaoke night ever! Singing J-pop songs while learning Japanese pronunciation was brilliant. Yuki made everyone feel comfortable even if they can't sing!
Dream come true for K-drama fans! Ji-woo is so sweet and patient. Practiced all my favorite drama phrases and the café was Instagram-perfect!
Lisbon at sunset is magical! Isabel's tour of the miradouros was perfectly timed. Golden hour photography while learning Portuguese was perfection.
Gaudí's work is mind-blowing! Carlos explained the architecture in Spanish so well. Sagrada Familia and Park Güell were highlights of my trip!
Ramen workshop was fantastic! Sakura is a patient teacher and the ramen we made was restaurant-quality. Learned so much Japanese cooking vocabulary!
Night market magic! Min-ji showed us authentic Korean street food and taught us how to order everything. Tteokbokki at Gwangjang is the best!
Great tapas and great Spanish practice! Carlos is enthusiastic and knows Barcelona inside out. The Gothic Quarter at night is beautiful.
Isabel's voice gave me chills! Understanding fado lyrics in Portuguese added so much depth to the experience. Alfama at night is romantic and perfect.
¡Muy auténtico! Miguel took us to places tourists never find. The street food was incredible and my Mexican Spanish vocabulary exploded!
Perfect Parisian morning! Sophie is knowledgeable, friendly, and made speaking French feel natural. The café setting removed all pressure. Loved it!
